# Neon Panel Demo (Android)

An original Android demo app inspired by dark neon gaming panels. It does not copy the BALA MOD name or branding.

## Features
- Local demo-key generator
- Login accepts keys generated in the current app session on this device
- Premium-style demo panel
- Functional local UI actions and logout
- No VPN, no network access, no external server, no real paid features

## Build
1. Open this folder in Android Studio (recent version).
2. Let Gradle sync.
3. Build > Build Bundle(s) / APK(s) > Build APK(s).

The generated demo keys are intentionally temporary and local. This is not secure production authentication and must not be marketed as real premium access.
